events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your fare-difference claim was reviewed and no refund is due. Your trip was a fixed-fare booking: you were quoted the price at booking and charged $23.32 for 9.9 km, which matches the best route for that trip. Although the driver went 1.8 km further than needed, that distance was never part of your charge on a fixed-fare trip, and there was no extra fee added on top. You agreed to the driver's named route before the trip, which covers the one off-route stretch. No refund is issued and no flag has been placed on your account.

DRIVER: No action is being taken against you. The rider's fare-difference claim was rejected. The trip was fixed-fare: the rider was quoted the price at booking and charged $23.32 for 9.9 km, which matches the best route, so the extra 1.8 km you drove did not affect the fare and there was no added charge to remove. The rider had agreed to your named route beforehand, which covers the single off-route segment. Nothing is being deducted and no flag has been placed on your account, so you can keep accepting trips as usual.
